comparison.objective: Refit an insect screen into all four window channels and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual frame handling, spring-plunger compression, swing-in alignment, and controlled seating.
comparison.success_condition: All edges seated, screen within 3°, plungers bearing, hands ≥2 cm clear and still for 1 s; drops or forced penetration zero.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant frame insertion into channels, not filtering loose media through apertures.
